product.name: Lians Guard
product.category: Current-state and completion guard for AI coding agents
product.summary: Lians Guard is the open-source state and evidence layer inside AI coding agents. The optional Mission Control beta gives one mission to one Codex thread, applies a bounded model policy, and blocks PASS until the user's verifier succeeds. Free local recovery remains available without a Lians account, AI account password, or separate provider API key.

workflow.label: Recover
workflow.detail: Restore the bounded current task, decisions, blockers, and next action in a supported Claude Code or Codex session.

workflow.label: Check freshness
workflow.detail: Compare the saved checkpoint with current repository and task state, and mark mismatches stale instead of silently reusing them.

workflow.label: Evaluate evidence
workflow.detail: Accept evidence only through a Lians-owned verifier, exact attested CI import, or interactive human confirmation while keeping agent attestations and inferred activity outside the completion gate.

workflow.label: Hand off to a human
workflow.detail: Show RECOVERED, STALE, BLOCKED, or READY FOR HUMAN REVIEW with inspectable evidence and remaining work.

surfaces.label: Free local recovery
surfaces.detail: Local memory, bounded recall, correction, deletion, and supported AI-client connections provide the individual recovery path.

surfaces.label: Typed task evidence gate
surfaces.detail: Task criteria distinguish measured evidence and human confirmation from agent-reported or inferred activity.

surfaces.label: Local Git checkpoint fingerprint
surfaces.detail: Task checkpoints record repository identity, HEAD, dirty state, and a digest of changed paths when Git is available.

surfaces.label: Automatic stale evidence invalidation
surfaces.detail: Workspace or requirement changes will invalidate dependent evidence and create a visible stale signal.

surfaces.label: Trusted GitHub Actions intake
surfaces.detail: CI evidence requires a verified GitHub attestation for the exact repository, signer workflow, source ref, commit, hosted runner, and selected passing checks, plus interactive authorization of the check-to-criterion mapping.

surfaces.label: Local Guard reporting
surfaces.detail: A local bounded report summarizes task states, missing criteria, untrusted evidence, and constraint failures without claiming business outcomes.

surfaces.label: Team Guard
surfaces.detail: Shared current state, completion policies, queue visibility, reporting, support, and managed operations for AI-native teams.

surfaces.label: Mission Control proof beta
surfaces.detail: A local application compares Protect and Maximum on matched tasks, requires verifier-backed completion, and exports privacy-bounded evidence. One mission uses one Codex app-server thread when supported, with a one-shot compatibility path while app-server remains experimental.
